Colonists are trapped in an emergency shelter after their settlement was overrun by the Arachnids.

Terran Command has tasked an elite detachment to save them from their dire predicament.
Capture Cargo Platforms to get additional Marauders

column2: Breaking news: A small mining colony has been overrun by the Arachnids. The few remaining survivors are currently held up in an emergency shelter.
Any plans of rescue and evacuation are on hold until the destruction of all Plasma Bugs in the area.
Given the urgency of the situation, the Mobile infantry has dispatched an elite detachment to get the job done.
All Plasma Bugs have been destroyed.
Capture the cargo dropsites to receive Marauders.
Which Marauder weapon setup do you want to receive?
